{{Quote|Have you ever heard of the Lost Jandosan Mines? I used to be one of the miners at Jandosan, until those dirty Veermoks decided to make it their home. Do you want to know where the mines used to be?|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac" />}}
'''Jandosan Mines''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining company]] based on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The company mined a large [[Veermok Cave|ore mine]] located in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]]. All mining activities were stopped when a pack of giant [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]] overtook the cave. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the veermoks still lived in the abandoned mine.<ref name="SWG:ac" />
